flows:
Navigate to https://www.axios.com/ then Use Tab, Shift+Tab, arrow keys, Page Up, Page Down, Home, End, text entry, Space and Enter only.
Remain on this public site.
Stop before sign-in, registration or payment.
If a CAPTCHA or access challenge appears, @v16:"stop and report it".
Never change fixture settings.
Use only visible controls.
Verify the final result on the page.
First, press Tab twice in the page before evaluating focusability.
Continue using Tab and Shift+Tab to reach the target.
check the open search control in the Axios header is in the sequential keyboard focus order.
Open search with Tab and Enter.
Verify a search text field is visible.
Stay on the public homepage.

summary:

Run from an approved test network or arrange an automation-safe access path with Axios/Cloudflare, then rerun the keyboard navigation check.
